status_summary: EO 14168, signed 2025-01-20, revokes EO 14020, which created the Gender Policy Council, and dissolves the council; it also revokes four other Biden-era orders on gender identity and equity (EOs 13988, 14004, 14021 and 14075) and directs agencies to rescind named guidance documents, mainly on LGBTQI+ students, Title IX and workplace harassment. The Mandate's second recommendation, a Special Assistant-level or higher coordinator for life and family priorities working with the Domestic Policy Council, was not found: the White House's annual reports to Congress on White House staff, as of 2025-07-01 and 2026-07-01, list Domestic Policy and Faith Office positions but none titled for life or family. Whether every Council product was rescinded was not checked.

timeline.event: EO 14168 signed: Section 7 revokes EO 14020 (Gender Policy Council) and four other orders and dissolves the council; agency heads are to rescind inconsistent guidance promptly.
EO 14168 published in the Federal Register (90 FR 8615).

title: Revoke the Gender Policy Council order and create a life and family coordinator
uncertainties: Only the Federal Register text of EO 14168 was read for the revocation. A limited search and the White House's annual reports to Congress on White House staff (as of 2025-07-01 and 2026-07-01) show no position titled for life or family; the White House Faith Office exists but has a different remit. The reports give job titles only, so a coordinator holding a general Domestic Policy title would not show, and absence from the lists is not proof that no such role exists. Lawsuits against EO 14168 concern its other provisions, not the council's dissolution. Searches on 2026-11-10 for a life and family coordinator or a revived Gender Policy Council found no such post or order; a search result list contained only news and reference pages. Absence is not proof.
